::api-operation{method="DELETE" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/coupons/{cpn}"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cpn` | `string` | **yes** | The coupon's id (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The coupon's id (`welcome-10`). |
| `code` | `string` | Same value as `id` — the code IS the id |
| `name` | `string` | The coupon's name. |
| `kind` | `string` | Whether the coupon takes off a percentage or a fixed amount. |
| `percent_off_bps` | `integer` | The percentage off in basis points (100 = 1%), for a percentage coupon. |
| `amount_off_minor` | `integer` | The fixed amount off, in minor units, for a fixed-amount coupon. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of `amount_off_minor` (ISO-4217 code). |
| `duration_type` | `string` | How long the discount lasts. |
| `duration_in_periods` | `integer` | The number of periods the discount lasts, for `repeating`. |
| `apply_on` | `string` | Whether the discount applies to the invoice amount or to each specified item. |
| `invoice_name` | `string` | The name printed on invoices for this discount. |
| `valid_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the coupon becomes valid (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `redeem_by` | `string · ISO-8601` | The last time the coupon can be redeemed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `times_redeemed` | `integer` | How many times the coupon has been redeemed. |
| `max_redemptions` | `integer` | The most times the coupon can be redeemed. |
| `max_redemptions_per_customer` | `integer` | Redemptions allowed per customer across their subscriptions; null = no cap. Applying past it is a 400. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the coupon is active. |
| `status` | `string` | Derived, in the business timezone — not a stored column One of `future`, `active`, `expired`, `archived`. |
| `item_constraints` | `array of object` | null when apply_on is not each_specified_item |
| `metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such coupon |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X DELETE "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/coupons/welcome-10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
